title: Overnight-intraday decomposition audit, adjusted-open data-integrity check and execution-convention policy

FE1_adjusted_open_integrity.expectation: adjusted ex-date overnight returns consistent with total-return accounting
FE1_adjusted_open_integrity.falsification_rule: pooled mean ex-date adjusted overnight return < -0.5 x median dividend yield

FE2_flagship_overnight_share.expectation: equity flagship overnight share of c2c edge >= 40%

FE3_intraday_excess.expectation: no strategy's intraday-only OOS Sharpe exceeds its c2c OOS Sharpe by more than 0.3

pre_registered.convention_dependence_flag: overnight placebo z >= 3 with c2c placebo z < 3

engines.weight_path: identical shifted + rebalance-sampled weights across conventions (identical turnover/costs)
engines.identity: per-asset c2c[t+1] = (1+overnight[t])*(1+intraday[t]) - 1, asserted < 1e-9 (verified empirically: 0.0; the two wrong alignments give 0.658 and 0.611 on the flagship)

pre_registered.futures_deseamed_opens: de-seamed open reconstructed by splitting each day's de-seamed return with the raw futures split on non-seam days and the paired spot ETF split on seam days
pre_registered.placebo_null: 12m block permutation of each strategy's signal (carry: E018 seam-calendar-preserving permutation of seam excess gaps)

part_d.policy: Recorded in ledger/PRIORITIZATION.md v1.2.4 (execution-convention policy): primary convention = close-to-close for both sleeves of any portfolio; promotion gates evaluated on the primary convention; overnight convention reported secondarily; mixed-convention portfolios prohibited (E020 lesson); convention-dependent strategies (overnight z >= 3, c2c z < 3) flagged for promotion re-examination; new engines must verify the per-asset accounting identity before results are trusted.
